[b]Nubiiv's Portraits [/b]

[u]Attention:[/u] Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portrait Template[/url] to work!

Welcome to my very first (and only) portrait mod for Stardew! It's still an ongoing project, so keep an eye for updates. I started with all bachelors and bachelorettes, the first version includes their base portraits. I'll add the variants (ginger island, nurse Maru) soon. 

Hope you enjoy it! If you find any issues with the mod, please let me know so I can fix it. 
You can find me at: [url=https://nubiiv.com]website[/url] - [url=https://www.instagram.com/nubiivstudio/]instagram [/url]- [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpFxVziQjXFWfjjKvbY230g]youtube [/url]- [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nubiivstudio]twitch [/url]

Next character in line: Robin 

Have fun!
